title: The Vibe Coding Cloud: Why Every AI-Built App Needs Production Infrastructure
summary: You built it with AI in 20 minutes. Now what? The vibe coding cloud is the missing layer — database, auth, and hosting that deploys as fast as AI writes code.
body_markdown: A typical production stack — Vercel, Supabase, Clerk, S3, QStash, Resend, OpenRouter, and a real-time service — runs roughly $295/month combined. Blink Cloud starts at $0 with a free tier that includes database, auth, and a preview URL on a Blink subdomain; production hosting and custom domains start on the $25/month Starter plan. Paid plans scale from there. You also eliminate 8 separate accounts, 8 dashboards, and the hours spent on initial configuration for each project.
